svg.title: The URL Field That Would Fetch Its Own Cloud Keys
svg.desc: An untrusted source page feeds URL links into the backlog list while one link branches off to a cloud-metadata server rack that hands out a key. Trace Bloom generative banner for “The URL Field That Would Fetch Its Own Cloud Keys”. A isometric lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 609230161.
